newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen attack ethnic party headquarters in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen attack ethnic party headquarters in Karachi.

text.p: Gunmen attacked the headquarters of an ethnic party in Pakistan's southern port city of Karachi on Tuesday, killing two party workers, police and party officials said.
Witnesses said unidentified gunmen attacked the main office, known as the White House, of the Haqiqi faction of the Mohajir National Movement (MQM), in the eastern district of Landhi.
"The terrorists attacked the White House from the back, killing our two workers," MQM-Haqiqi spokesman Younus Khan said, naming the dead as Kashif Qayum, 18, and Naveed Ahmed, 21.
MQM-Haqiqi has long feuded with the mainstream MQM, which is now part of Sindh province's coalition government.
Younus said the assailants came on foot and vanished in the narrow streets after firing on the White House. "The police were there, but did nothing to stop them," he said.
The attack followed a separate shooting in Karachi on Monday night in which five young people, including a 16-year-old girl, were killed by gunmen firing from a moving car.
